title: From Outranking Flow Scores to Linear Programs: Group Decision Making in PROMETHEE II
abstract: arXiv:2610.34481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study inverse and consensus analysis for PROMETHEE II ranking problems when the performance table is fixed. Existing approaches in PROMETHEE-based sensitivity and consensus analysis usually focus on deviations of criteria weights while treating preference functions as fixed. Nevertheless both sets of parameters jointly determine the outranking flow scores. We introduce a linear reparametrization of the PROMETHEE II net flow scores based on weighted preference increments over the observed differences of performances. This representation yields a linear expression of the net flows and clarifies how weights and preference functions interact. translated_title: 从级别高于流得分到线性规划：PROMETHEE II中的群体决策
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在性能表固定的情况下，PROMETHEE II排序问题的逆向分析与共识分析。现有基于PROMETHEE的敏感性与共识分析方法通常只关注准则权重的偏差，而将偏好函数视为固定不变。然而，这两组参数共同决定了级别高于流得分。我们引入了一种基于观测性能差异的加权偏好增量的PROMETHEE II净流得分的线性重参数化方法。这种表示形式给出了净流的线性表达式，并阐明了权重与偏好函数之间的相互作用方式。基于这一结果，我们针对三种情形导出了线性优化模型：在允许偏好函数变化的情况下最小化权重偏差；在整个偏好参数集合上最小化偏差；以及多决策者共识分析（其目标基于……）
tldr: 本文提出了一种PROMETHEE II净流得分的线性重参数化方法，将准则权重与偏好函数统一纳入线性框架，从而能够为权重偏差最小化、全参数偏差最小化以及多决策者共识分析等三种情形构建线性优化模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a linear reparametrization of PROMETHEE II net flow scores that jointly accounts for criteria weights and preference functions, enabling linear optimization models for weight-deviation minimization, full-parameter deviation minimization, and multi-decision-maker consensus analysis.
